faq.q: How many blades does the Multi-blade Saw MJ1300-XD3 use?
faq.a: It is a multi-blade configuration that cuts several boards in a single pass, which cuts cycle time and sawing cost per cubic metre compared with single-blade sawing.

faq.q: What size of logs or timber can be cut?
faq.a: Maximum sawing height is the rated height, covering the log and timber sizes typical of sawmills and panel plants. Please send your cutting list for a specific recommendation.

faq.q: What is the material yield like?
faq.a: Because several blades work in one pass, kerf loss is spread across more boards, so overall material yield is higher than repeated single-blade cuts.

faq.q: Is CE certification available for this machine?
faq.a: Yes, CE certification is available for the multi-blade saw series from Shang Rui Machinery.
